headline: Ganges Securities files scrutinizer report and voting results for postal ballot

modes.bear: Routine paperwork offers no new growth drivers for the stock.
modes.bull: Compliance is up to date, ensuring steady administrative operations.

summary: Ganges Securities Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer report and voting results for its recent postal ballot to the stock exchanges. This regulatory filing completes the mandatory shareholder voting process for the company. Retail investors should note this is standard corporate governance compliance rather than a market-moving event.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock price
